title: Smoked Steak with Velvety Stew
description: A hearty steak dish paired with a rich, creamy stew. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: 2. Season steak with salt and pepper. Sear in a skillet for 2-3 minutes per side.
3. Finish cooking steak in oven for 10-12 minutes to desired doneness.
4. While steak cooks, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
6. Add onion, garlic, smoked paprika, and chili flakes. Cook for 2 minutes.
7. Add red wine and bring to a boil.
8. Scrape up browned bits from skillet and add tomato paste.
9. Simmer stew for 20-25 minutes or until meat is tender.
10. Stir in diced tomatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
11. Serve steak with velvety stew spooned over the top.
12. Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or thyme.
